newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki up but off peaks as Nokia corrects lower.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki up but off peaks as Nokia corrects lower.

text.p: Shares closed higher on Thursday but trimmed gains in a late correction as profit-taking in the U.S. dragged Nokia and the Dow Jones index and made the outlook again more nervous, brokers said.
The HEX index was up 0.72 percent at 2,807.36 points after trading in a 2,787.41-2,815.25 range, and the FOX derivatives and portfolio benchmark closed up 0.83 percent at 979.09 points.
Volume was still modest at 454 million markka with 25 percent in bourse engine Nokia.

Nokia propelled the bourse's gains for most of the session on a strong recovery overnight, but came off its 300.00 markka peak to close up 3.00 markka at 297.00, matching the early drop in its ADR on Wall Street.
Nokia was cheered by a positive report in a U.S. paper on Tuesday, brokers said, but some said its upside was capped by uncertainty ahead of its first quarter earnings due on April 29.

Forestry major UPM-Kymmene advanced 3.20 markka to 113.20, pulling the forestry sub-index to a 2.22 percent rise amid continued speculation that it may buy parts of Canadian paper group Repap, which it has shown interested in earlier.
"Repap's acquisition would mark a beginning to UPM's landing in North-America," one broker said.

Diversified consumer goods group Hackman rose sharply in healthy trade as investors saw increasing value in its environmental technology unit Hadwaco after it on Tuesday announced a marketing partnership agreement with U.S. Filter Corporation. It closed up 9.00 markka at 150.00 markka.
